6e68cf46-c089-47b4-8bc7-e53debab6233.label: cymbiont
6e68cf46-c089-47b4-8bc7-e53debab6233.description: Python package and overall system providing knowledge-graph, RAG, voice, and coding-agent integration capabilities.

3f739b0f-3f10-4441-a8a0-2ffb03d900e4.label: claude-code
3f739b0f-3f10-4441-a8a0-2ffb03d900e4.description: Anthropic's coding agent, one of the supported integrations for the Cymbiont memory harness.

b44dfba7-be6d-4c99-ad56-2a4dce1052b6.label: pi
b44dfba7-be6d-4c99-ad56-2a4dce1052b6.description: Pi coding agent, the alternative harness target supported alongside Claude Code in Cymbiont.

6cf09b15-de29-4d08-8c25-b3dd1fe030a6.label: knowledge-graph-memory
6cf09b15-de29-4d08-8c25-b3dd1fe030a6.description: Autonomic memory subsystem that extracts entities and relationships from conversations and documents; retrieval is injected as context each turn without manual intervention.

b02f96be-88c9-4383-9120-6cab026b8f7b.label: per-turn-audit-loop
b02f96be-88c9-4383-9120-6cab026b8f7b.description: Background agent that judges whether retrieved KG context was relevant each turn, feeding signal back to lexicon maintenance.

c7b6886a-0983-461d-8dc5-d8e89cda6cf4.label: voice-harness
c7b6886a-0983-461d-8dc5-d8e89cda6cf4.description: Speech-to-text in / text-to-speech out subsystem that accumulates fine-tuning data passively during use.

d8b02c3d-4b42-4854-b1da-c5e3bf746b97.label: hook-budget
d8b02c3d-4b42-4854-b1da-c5e3bf746b97.description: Shared guard for Claude Code's ~10 KB per-hook additionalContext cap; logs overflow via report_error without trimming content.

2c83fdba-6462-4a4e-a344-1d0a1339c63e.label: whisper-server
2c83fdba-6462-4a4e-a344-1d0a1339c63e.description: whisper.cpp HTTP server running on port 8080 with CUDA acceleration, used for speech-to-text transcription.

147fcb1f-eeea-472a-bd03-0ac4e6558322.label: pocket-tts
147fcb1f-eeea-472a-bd03-0ac4e6558322.description: Kyutai's 100M-param CPU-native TTS server (port 8890) with voice cloning, RTF ~0.34 on CPU.

6ca3143b-ea26-4b88-86d8-4165579c05e5.label: miniLM
6ca3143b-ea26-4b88-86d8-4165579c05e5.description: Sentence embedding model served by Cymbiont's RAG service to power KG node embeddings.

65fb2386-dc55-47b7-8aaa-feef55b1ea6c.label: rolling-context
65fb2386-dc55-47b7-8aaa-feef55b1ea6c.description: Sliding-window conversation context that rotates out oldest entries once the word cap is reached.

3bb5826e-d97c-4507-951d-10344ee77d2d.label: cymbiont-core
3bb5826e-d97c-4507-951d-10344ee77d2d.description: Shared orchestration module (hooks, error reporting, paths) within the cymbiont package.

5ad8f3e2-41bd-430b-87e1-4373222152ba.label: cymbiont-kg
5ad8f3e2-41bd-430b-87e1-4373222152ba.description: Knowledge-graph engine, server, retrieval, and agents subsystem within the cymbiont package.

484c22a5-cfcc-4d11-9625-e3046d70b3a1.label: cymbiont-voice
484c22a5-cfcc-4d11-9625-e3046d70b3a1.description: Voice subsystem within cymbiont containing STT, TTS, and finetuning components.

4457bd8f-84c6-4291-a386-904574a2c0c9.label: knowledge-graph-rag
4457bd8f-84c6-4291-a386-904574a2c0c9.description: Retrieval augmented generation approach using a knowledge graph to store and retrieve memories as entities and relationships.

b6004150-b87a-4b5f-816d-0c7610ed6ad5.label: autonomic-memory
b6004150-b87a-4b5f-816d-0c7610ed6ad5.description: Retrieval that happens before the agent knows what it's looking for, before deliberate action — the key value proposition of graph-based RAG over direct search.

5d28a36c-0437-4f79-a2f3-fdbcf9855724.label: pi-coding-agent
5d28a36c-0437-4f79-a2f3-fdbcf9855724.description: Open-source coding agent (earendil-works/pi-coding-agent) supported as a Cymbiont integration.

90485595-2b35-4f29-b9fe-71cc43f13324.label: whisper
90485595-2b35-4f29-b9fe-71cc43f13324.description: OpenAI's automatic speech recognition model that Cymbiont uses as its STT backend and fine-tunes for speaker personalization.

8a6ca69e-6bae-4de9-ba39-8b67966f5136.label: zuhandenheit
8a6ca69e-6bae-4de9-ba39-8b67966f5136.description: Heideggerian concept of 'readiness-to-hand' — the quality making a tool feel useful precisely because it fades into the background; Cymbiont's design philosophy.

aad5de3e-3f89-4691-b186-22bee2388ee6.label: graph-traversal
aad5de3e-3f89-4691-b186-22bee2388ee6.description: Navigation of graph edges to discover related nodes; enables scalable retrieval that doesn't degrade with larger knowledge bases.

58c8d92c-10e3-4c29-b48b-f332257ad963.label: headless-agent
58c8d92c-10e3-4c29-b48b-f332257ad963.description: One-shot, non-persistent AI agent used in Cymbiont for background tasks; has a universal 30-minute hard kill timeout.

0f6ee4c6-b6aa-4bdc-aa9b-38ea6570e1af.label: hyprland
0f6ee4c6-b6aa-4bdc-aa9b-38ea6570e1af.description: Tiling Wayland compositor that the Cymbiont voice harness is written against; uses hyprctl for window management.

69d8a31b-3055-429c-9d4d-3f0503ee68a9.label: wayland
69d8a31b-3055-429c-9d4d-3f0503ee68a9.description: Linux display server protocol; required by the Cymbiont voice harness for clipboard and window operations.

92a1c578-d71b-4b0c-a406-5e0ba49cb2fe.label: pipewire
92a1c578-d71b-4b0c-a406-5e0ba49cb2fe.description: Linux audio server used for audio capture and playback via pw-record and pw-play.

22bc6b16-685e-49e8-a75e-a6f93cd8074d.label: whisper-cpp
22bc6b16-685e-49e8-a75e-a6f93cd8074d.description: C++ runtime for Whisper used as Cymbiont's default STT backend; cannot load LoRA adapters directly, requiring merge-then-reconvert for deployment.

1c62e02a-a68f-4587-9d67-70c8eaf8271b.label: wl-clipboard
1c62e02a-a68f-4587-9d67-70c8eaf8271b.description: Wayland clipboard utility (wl-copy/wl-paste) used by the voice harness to paste transcriptions.

1b978583-cba4-4013-b7e2-b42fc953bd4a.label: hugging-face
1b978583-cba4-4013-b7e2-b42fc953bd4a.description: ML model hosting platform; required for pocket-tts voice-cloning model login.

7004d17e-e713-4f59-b3b6-50275d16dc42.label: cuda-gpu
7004d17e-e713-4f59-b3b6-50275d16dc42.description: NVIDIA GPU with CUDA support; required for usable latency when running whisper-server transcription.

e1d61030-1bca-4ac1-a456-2f7b92a0918a.label: install-sh
e1d61030-1bca-4ac1-a456-2f7b92a0918a.description: Deterministic, reversible shell installer for cymbiont; checks Python version, installs package editable, downloads NLTK corpora, and renders systemd/Claude Code config templates into build/.

361c1e5e-6de7-4d40-8f92-5c65bcd743ac.label: nltk
361c1e5e-6de7-4d40-8f92-5c65bcd743ac.description: Natural Language Toolkit; cymbiont downloads its corpora for use in the graph engine.

e05b72e2-e490-4b69-9aab-5873e5daa853.label: systemd
e05b72e2-e490-4b69-9aab-5873e5daa853.description: Linux init system; cymbiont renders a systemd unit template into build/ during installation.

f8fd1bd6-d036-44f3-bcc9-8162ee0d479a.label: virtualenv
f8fd1bd6-d036-44f3-bcc9-8162ee0d479a.description: Python virtual environment tool; recommended for isolating cymbiont's dependencies from system Python.

86fe04b9-bb46-47c2-a307-cf6153f200de.label: kg-server
86fe04b9-bb46-47c2-a307-cf6153f200de.description: HTTP server that is the sole sanctioned interface for graph access; never import graph.py directly in new code.

2ca670c9-ad37-4da0-8a86-f26f2c899daa.label: rag-watcher
2ca670c9-ad37-4da0-8a86-f26f2c899daa.description: Companion HTTP service on port 8891 that performs the actual MiniLM text encoding; kg-server batches embedding requests to it.

2a4e59dd-09a1-47e5-a663-878c0f0a449e.label: nixos
2a4e59dd-09a1-47e5-a663-878c0f0a449e.description: Linux distribution using the Nix package manager; requires LD_LIBRARY_PATH set to nix-ld path so pip-installed torch can find native libraries.

e5961572-03a7-4529-80d8-cea825fb2d36.label: nix-ld
e5961572-03a7-4529-80d8-cea825fb2d36.description: NixOS component that provides a compatibility layer for dynamically linked binaries; cymbiont systemd units set LD_LIBRARY_PATH to its library path.

4a6b0841-7cc9-4112-a2f8-33c791e32cd5.label: cymbiont-active-harness
4a6b0841-7cc9-4112-a2f8-33c791e32cd5.description: Environment variable (CYMBIONT_ACTIVE_HARNESS) that controls which coding agent harness headless background agents spawn with.

98c09904-0edd-47fa-bb02-c9dfc6f4af35.label: cymbiont-ts
98c09904-0edd-47fa-bb02-c9dfc6f4af35.description: Pi extension that bridges Pi's lifecycle events to the same Python hooks Claude Code uses.

f25b7c08-3a40-48a7-9775-7ed57780cb25.label: commands-ts
f25b7c08-3a40-48a7-9775-7ed57780cb25.description: Pi extension that registers Cymbiont's Markdown command files as Pi slash commands, keeping them a single source of truth across both harnesses.

8ffdbf1d-8c84-4067-8f26-7516e2b07651.label: searxng
8ffdbf1d-8c84-4067-8f26-7516e2b07651.description: Search engine package recommended for use with Pi agent; enabled via Pi settings.

deed4b58-a04f-499c-accc-00710f88c1f5.label: cmake
deed4b58-a04f-499c-accc-00710f88c1f5.description: Cross-platform build system used to compile whisper.cpp with CUDA and server targets.

bf52cf2c-b248-4628-b972-93fe49cb8aa9.label: patchelf
bf52cf2c-b248-4628-b972-93fe49cb8aa9.description: Linux utility that rewrites ELF binary headers; required on NixOS to fix store paths after building native binaries.

64650bf1-b64d-431c-94b5-9486fd98b564.label: ggml-format
64650bf1-b64d-431c-94b5-9486fd98b564.description: Binary model file format (.bin) used by whisper.cpp for storing quantized speech recognition weights.

43b1b822-561b-4a12-95f6-d71e76f67c64.label: large-v3
43b1b822-561b-4a12-95f6-d71e76f67c64.description: OpenAI Whisper large-v3 model variant in ggml format, used for high-accuracy speech recognition.

ba35a7a3-29ba-46dd-878a-7bc828025bfa.label: pocket-tts-server
ba35a7a3-29ba-46dd-878a-7bc828025bfa.description: systemd user service that wraps pocket-tts to provide local text-to-speech synthesis.

4ff5e43a-3fdd-4417-80eb-db98a626b0d6.label: config-toml
4ff5e43a-3fdd-4417-80eb-db98a626b0d6.description: Root-level TOML file that stores all Cymbiont harness hyperparameters, read by cymbiont/config.py at startup.

744c94bc-fe6e-43cd-a04d-7ea31b307697.label: rolling-context-store
744c94bc-fe6e-43cd-a04d-7ea31b307697.description: In-memory store that accumulates conversation context and rotates oldest entries out once the cumulative word count exceeds word_cap.

40729ecf-4450-46fb-afde-6275297c3be4.label: word-cap
40729ecf-4450-46fb-afde-6275297c3be4.description: config.toml setting controlling the maximum cumulative word count in the rolling-context store before entries are evicted.

ca483787-f17c-438d-9d2b-fa6235fd0928.label: ingest-trigger-every
ca483787-f17c-438d-9d2b-fa6235fd0928.description: config.toml setting that controls how many user messages elapse between knowledge-graph ingestion agent firings.

dfd622b5-1a0e-4d03-91c4-1efc3e3c34ab.label: kg-ingestion-agent
dfd622b5-1a0e-4d03-91c4-1efc3e3c34ab.description: Background headless agent that periodically extracts entities and relationships from conversation and writes them to the knowledge graph.

c2c7c754-ec70-46f3-b88c-7bd71cb7b3f9.label: agent-timeout
c2c7c754-ec70-46f3-b88c-7bd71cb7b3f9.description: Universal hard cap in seconds applied to every headless background agent subprocess (ingestion, audit, summarization, lexicon maintenance).

3b089100-e0d6-459e-b37d-62a0e70e4c05.label: hard-timeout
3b089100-e0d6-459e-b37d-62a0e70e4c05.description: Universal 30-minute (1800s) hard cap applied to every background agent in Cymbiont, beyond all soft timeouts.

ec11649f-42a2-4ab8-850f-b1b3a866fd3a.label: soft-timeout
ec11649f-42a2-4ab8-850f-b1b3a866fd3a.description: Per-agent expected ceiling timeout (e.g. summary_soft_timeout, audit_soft_timeout) that operates within the hard timeout bound.

d2bf452d-0ef5-4d60-a239-dc68583f0bc1.label: harness-errors-log
d2bf452d-0ef5-4d60-a239-dc68583f0bc1.description: File at audit_reports/harness_errors.jsonl that records agents killed at the hard timeout limit.

ce128b06-e56a-4a50-8c74-46f3e5a0b4e2.label: voice-config-toml
ce128b06-e56a-4a50-8c74-46f3e5a0b4e2.description: TOML config file under the data root holding post-transcription find-and-replace rules for STT corrections of project names, coined terms, and proper nouns.

92c8d6e6-972f-4ee9-a9bf-3f0f731b46ba.label: stt-text-replacements
92c8d6e6-972f-4ee9-a9bf-3f0f731b46ba.description: Post-transcription find-and-replace rules that correct speech-to-text misrecognitions for project-specific terms and proper nouns.

0c406030-7cca-4525-bb1d-384d852e14c6.label: progressive-recorder
0c406030-7cca-4525-bb1d-384d852e14c6.description: Cymbiont component that passively writes (audio, text) chunk pairs to the training data directory during normal dictation use.

c9668f29-9a98-4bed-a7f1-2b72e6ef3fde.label: manual-mistranscription-workflow
c9668f29-9a98-4bed-a7f1-2b72e6ef3fde.description: Workflow for handling STT errors that require human review rather than automatic replacement rules.

586c5622-d80d-470b-b889-46e227eb5d72.label: cymbiont-data-root
586c5622-d80d-470b-b889-46e227eb5d72.description: Single mutable directory for all Cymbiont runtime state, resolved from CYMBIONT_DATA, XDG_DATA_HOME, or ~/.local/share/cymbiont

d4feb43b-fd82-4449-af51-dc041b3ed269.label: kg-store
d4feb43b-fd82-4449-af51-dc041b3ed269.description: Single JSON file at kg/store.json that persists the entire knowledge graph

43a79bfd-5e29-4985-9efd-40341a272877.label: running-context
43a79bfd-5e29-4985-9efd-40341a272877.description: Rolling context store (running_context.json) injected into each cymbiont session

ddd79f29-55a1-4716-985f-e504dc0a7104.label: audit-reports
ddd79f29-55a1-4716-985f-e504dc0a7104.description: Background-agent output directory containing reports and harness_errors.jsonl

58893bcc-396a-4a5e-a41e-e1a72b507a65.label: voice-training-data
58893bcc-396a-4a5e-a41e-e1a72b507a65.description: Passively collected (audio, text) pairs stored in voice/training_data/ for Whisper fine-tuning

b1a27224-0884-402a-9479-256f9449a08b.label: lora-finetuning
b1a27224-0884-402a-9479-256f9449a08b.description: Parameter-efficient fine-tuning method that trains a small adapter over base weights; used to adapt Whisper to a speaker's voice without full-weight training.

444d36da-a576-4653-b8d7-7f35df9ead7f.label: catastrophic-forgetting-replay
444d36da-a576-4653-b8d7-7f35df9ead7f.description: Replay buffer technique used during fine-tuning to preserve general speech recognition ability while adapting to new speaker data.

493e30eb-079b-4e10-8034-ec6d8008bc3f.label: word-error-rate
493e30eb-079b-4e10-8034-ec6d8008bc3f.description: Standard metric (WER) for evaluating speech recognition accuracy, used as a baseline before and after fine-tuning.

132c388b-e573-4eda-af6e-f7bab4c97a35.label: cymbiont-rag
132c388b-e573-4eda-af6e-f7bab4c97a35.description: RAG subsystem providing MiniLM embedding server and workspace file-watcher within cymbiont.

267b22da-3ed0-4b18-b619-f6ab9bf99568.label: coding-agent-harness
267b22da-3ed0-4b18-b619-f6ab9bf99568.description: Wiring layer in cymbiont/harness/ that connects coding agents (claude-code, pi) to the system.

6af53036-3e61-4f73-ad04-438db23ddd60.label: workspace-file-watcher
6af53036-3e61-4f73-ad04-438db23ddd60.description: Component in the cymbiont RAG subsystem that monitors workspace files for changes to trigger re-indexing.

f7bfd4ad-e214-4248-8417-879bdcaf1911.label: kg-engine
f7bfd4ad-e214-4248-8417-879bdcaf1911.description: Knowledge graph engine powering Cymbiont's memory harness, where nodes and edges are both first-class Thought objects inspired by BrainSim UKS.

5baa524b-96c5-403b-a856-8b360f6e5f75.label: charles-simon
5baa524b-96c5-403b-a856-8b360f6e5f75.description: Researcher who developed BrainSim and the Universal Knowledge Store (UKS) model that inspired Cymbiont's KG design.

24506d9c-e5ff-4a99-8b82-b148f85856c7.label: brainsim-uks
24506d9c-e5ff-4a99-8b82-b148f85856c7.description: BrainSim Universal Knowledge Store by Charles Simon; both nodes and edges are first-class Thought objects — the design inspiration for Cymbiont's KG engine.

8df0de27-2d1f-4eb4-b9f8-aecbae5944da.label: thought-node
8df0de27-2d1f-4eb4-b9f8-aecbae5944da.description: BrainSim-derived design pattern where both graph nodes and graph edges are first-class objects of the same type (Thought).

3ac2692f-1472-4711-809a-c97f89e6c09f.label: kg-retriever
3ac2692f-1472-4711-809a-c97f89e6c09f.description: The KG retrieval system that calls /term-match, applies cross-turn dedup, ranks by hit-count, and injects term descriptions into the agent context.

b876cbee-afad-40e2-a77b-acbccffdf1d1.label: diff-sync
b876cbee-afad-40e2-a77b-acbccffdf1d1.description: Autonomous entity extractor that fires on workspace document diffs detected by the file-watcher.

040ae3e3-f8b9-4d13-8f96-e916a5570da5.label: kg-tool
040ae3e3-f8b9-4d13-8f96-e916a5570da5.description: CLI script (cymbiont/kg/kg_tool.py) that exposes all KG operations via HTTP calls to the running KG server.

c917d019-2ad5-462b-8738-01bc0685af96.label: describe-corrector
c917d019-2ad5-462b-8738-01bc0685af96.description: Triggered agent that condenses node descriptions that exceeded the length cap and were rejected by the ingest agent.

0814ea4d-f9ea-42fa-8e81-eb39e0995a26.label: colonization-verdicts
0814ea4d-f9ea-42fa-8e81-eb39e0995a26.description: Resolved-verdict registry that suppresses re-flagging of colonized nodes already reviewed and adjudicated by a human reviewer.

7fc16f4f-bb87-4d53-9b84-2f7165ed37ab.label: personalized-pagerank
7fc16f4f-bb87-4d53-9b84-2f7165ed37ab.description: Graph traversal algorithm used for KG retrieval seed expansion; is-a edges enable transitive discovery of connected nodes.

ec00fdb2-8694-4cfb-9cfd-76c7f3c8c20b.label: injected-ledger
ec00fdb2-8694-4cfb-9cfd-76c7f3c8c20b.description: Per-session deduplication tracker that filters already-shown triples and term descriptions from subsequent hook injections to avoid repetition across turns.

70067b00-8cc2-45f1-96aa-e2a27f9d0de4.label: kg-thought
70067b00-8cc2-45f1-96aa-e2a27f9d0de4.description: Universal unit of the knowledge graph; both nodes and edges are Thought objects, distinguished only by the presence of link_data on edge Thoughts.

c84855b4-9e2d-4f45-87ed-456c221f13b4.label: description-too-long-error
c84855b4-9e2d-4f45-87ed-456c221f13b4.description: Validation error raised by cymbiont.kg.graph when a node description exceeds the hard 100-word cap enforced at every write site.

666fec76-3ee5-4e5e-9095-ca4c456009bf.label: term-matching
666fec76-3ee5-4e5e-9095-ca4c456009bf.description: KG-based keyword router that matches node labels against user input text to retrieve relevant term descriptions.

1cbaedbf-85cf-46b3-9d17-728018bdbbb1.label: porter-stemmer
1cbaedbf-85cf-46b3-9d17-728018bdbbb1.description: Suffix-stripping stemmer used during seed extraction to match query tokens against KG node labels via POS-tagging and stem comparison.

a12d67e6-fe1a-4aa5-a763-447a99992e88.label: hit-count
a12d67e6-fe1a-4aa5-a763-447a99992e88.description: All-time retrieval usefulness counter on KG nodes; used to rank and prioritize which terms ship first when the per-turn cap is exceeded.

310ce5fc-ee7f-4fe7-9dab-96b3ccace712.label: terms-per-retrieve
310ce5fc-ee7f-4fe7-9dab-96b3ccace712.description: Config constant (default 20, in cymbiont.config) capping the number of term descriptions injected per turn to stay within Claude Code's hook byte limit.

0007cb7b-0f57-4e71-8686-7de8f120dd07.label: cross-turn-dedup
0007cb7b-0f57-4e71-8686-7de8f120dd07.description: Mechanism that records matched terms in the injected-ledger so they are not re-injected on subsequent turns within the same session.

c25e02f5-6f85-4bdf-a800-83628962fb27.label: edge-expiration
c25e02f5-6f85-4bdf-a800-83628962fb27.description: Soft-delete mechanism for KG edges via expired_at timestamp; excluded from traversal and retrieval but retained for audit.

e5d7c12e-845b-4f57-badf-fd942a4bf192.label: expire-operation
e5d7c12e-845b-4f57-badf-fd942a4bf192.description: KG operation that marks an edge as no longer true due to a changed fact, distinct from hard removal.

e00332e8-7a85-4451-b26a-de17a019b977.label: remove-edge-operation
e00332e8-7a85-4451-b26a-de17a019b977.description: KG operation that hard-removes an edge that was never true, such as extraction errors or duplicates.

fc5afa57-73fe-470a-8c74-b96f7bb2ac74.label: unexpire-operation
fc5afa57-73fe-470a-8c74-b96f7bb2ac74.description: KG operation that reverts a premature edge expiration, restoring the edge to active status.

9f77eb47-b5d0-4d4e-9d6d-a64ac5ae9a6e.label: commutative-edge-type
9f77eb47-b5d0-4d4e-9d6d-a64ac5ae9a6e.description: Edge predicate type (e.g. relates-to) where expiring or removing one direction automatically mirrors the operation on the reverse edge.

ea82b99c-da3b-4c58-b39a-563240153706.label: session-agent
ea82b99c-da3b-4c58-b39a-563240153706.description: Persistent agent that reviews KG state per session and can revert premature expirations via unexpire.

5b506c19-484a-487d-83c1-fa22a616963e.label: edge-clause
5b506c19-484a-487d-83c1-fa22a616963e.description: Typed annotation on a KG edge (BECAUSE or WITH) that explains why a relationship exists or under what circumstances it holds.

d5ce2d46-5906-425a-a531-b22f14ff1b62.label: because-clause
d5ce2d46-5906-425a-a531-b22f14ff1b62.description: Edge clause type indicating causal reason why a relationship exists; stored in link_data.clauses.

4c396aba-f2e3-4461-989d-1bf2a5da307b.label: with-clause
4c396aba-f2e3-4461-989d-1bf2a5da307b.description: Edge clause type indicating a contextual modifier — the circumstances under which a relationship holds.

66779ccb-099c-41a0-80c8-f668f07a4ee5.label: bfs-retrieval
66779ccb-099c-41a0-80c8-f668f07a4ee5.description: Breadth-first search traversal path used during KG context retrieval; carries edge clauses inline.

8d9a3373-cbc0-4349-b2f4-c974f7ed4049.label: ppr-retrieval
8d9a3373-cbc0-4349-b2f4-c974f7ed4049.description: Personalized PageRank traversal path used during KG context retrieval; carries edge clauses inline.

705aacf1-f02c-4ce2-bd8d-3444f8fbb4c6.label: persistent-pool
705aacf1-f02c-4ce2-bd8d-3444f8fbb4c6.description: Standing retrieval path that carries edge clause annotations alongside triples during context assembly.

978ea116-ee1a-406b-b16c-59ab561a5e0d.label: bad-clauses
978ea116-ee1a-406b-b16c-59ab561a5e0d.description: Audit verdict field flagging edge clauses that are tautological, speculative, or factually wrong.

172dfb6d-294f-4282-ac8c-4d74702b99c4.label: mmr-rerank
172dfb6d-294f-4282-ac8c-4d74702b99c4.description: Maximal Marginal Relevance reranking step applied after PPR traversal in the /retrieve pipeline to balance relevance and diversity in returned triples.

0fb4344a-9ccf-4c18-8dd7-6149d3cbb020.label: hub-suppression
0fb4344a-9ccf-4c18-8dd7-6149d3cbb020.description: Inverse-frequency penalty dividing PPR scores by log(1+degree)^INV_FREQ_ALPHA to prevent high-degree hub nodes from dominating retrieval results.

cdab348e-3ccd-4dfe-a3aa-78f6fdb09187.label: hook-byte-limit
cdab348e-3ccd-4dfe-a3aa-78f6fdb09187.description: 10 KB hard cap (CC_HOOK_BYTE_LIMIT) on UserPromptSubmit hook injection size, shared constant in cymbiont.core.hook_budget; triggers trim of longest term descriptions when exceeded.

3f20d533-f86b-41f7-badb-1a20a8f6a85b.label: background-embed
3f20d533-f86b-41f7-badb-1a20a8f6a85b.description: Daemon thread spawned by kg-server after a mutation that coalesces concurrent re-embed triggers and calls out to rag-watcher for MiniLM encoding without blocking the main request threads.

b784d3c9-85f4-4d0a-93f6-1f87aab28582.label: batch-update-endpoint
b784d3c9-85f4-4d0a-93f6-1f87aab28582.description: HTTP endpoint for bulk KG node updates that performs a single graph save, avoiding the N×40 MB write cost of looping /update-node.

7e389eb2-f062-42c3-819a-c401782f90a9.label: ingest-endpoint
7e389eb2-f062-42c3-819a-c401782f90a9.description: The /ingest HTTP endpoint on kg-server; merges extracted entities and relationships while enforcing orphan-guard and description-word-cap constraints.

4fdbf06c-00c2-499d-a735-cedb657865a1.label: orphan-guard
4fdbf06c-00c2-499d-a735-cedb657865a1.description: Ingest-time rule that rejects NEW entities not referenced as subject or object in the same payload's relationships, preventing isolated orphan nodes from entering the graph.

3122b375-939d-46d7-8dd2-76be9d15fc5a.label: description-word-cap
3122b375-939d-46d7-8dd2-76be9d15fc5a.description: Maximum word count enforced on node descriptions at ingest and update time; violations are counted in entities_rejected_overlong and fed to the description corrector.

ee5bd6f2-2d72-42ce-b48d-016d4939c361.label: harness-errors
ee5bd6f2-2d72-42ce-b48d-016d4939c361.description: cymbiont.core.harness_errors — central error reception point that tees every logger.exception call (including kg-server embedding and request-handler failures) to the audit-reports directory.

eefdc8b0-acbe-4326-88c5-f133c526c31c.label: expire-edge
eefdc8b0-acbe-4326-88c5-f133c526c31c.description: Soft-delete mechanism for KG edges exposed via /expire-edge and /unexpire-edge endpoints, enabling bi-temporal fact invalidation without permanently removing graph structure.

15818eaf-bdab-4177-8dc9-96b61475d93b.label: npz-atomic-save
15818eaf-bdab-4177-8dc9-96b61475d93b.description: Helper _save_npz_atomic that passes a file object to np.savez_compressed to avoid numpy silently appending .npz to a temp filename, ensuring atomic embedding index saves.

a7b8ff04-a90d-4b5d-ae43-dae7b23403bf.label: jaro-winkler
a7b8ff04-a90d-4b5d-ae43-dae7b23403bf.description: String similarity algorithm used alongside MiniLM embeddings in the `similar` command to detect near-duplicate node labels.

ee1ee3e6-0b99-47d7-b2a0-5ed3085bca05.label: ingestion-agent
ee1ee3e6-0b99-47d7-b2a0-5ed3085bca05.description: Headless LLM agent firing every 5 messages and at session end to extract entities and relationships from the conversation window and merge them into the KG; primary owner of node descriptions.

ebc27eed-fd09-491e-8097-3c750f97f91f.label: maintenance-agent
ebc27eed-fd09-491e-8097-3c750f97f91f.description: Daily scheduled agent performing semantic dedup, orphan cleanup, colonization flagging grounded in centrality, and health reporting; writes findings to kg-issues.jsonl for human review.

9724a690-cd9f-4368-b230-7ac0b1956376.label: description-correction-agent
9724a690-cd9f-4368-b230-7ac0b1956376.description: Detached headless Sonnet agent triggered when /ingest rejects an over-cap description; condenses the description to under the word cap by iterating via kg_tool.py until the write lands.

52248fa7-269b-4527-b553-f28e2dbde49b.label: colonization-verdict-registry
52248fa7-269b-4527-b553-f28e2dbde49b.description: Git-tracked JSON registry keyed on node label storing resolved colonization verdicts (split/rejected/renamed) with edge-signatures to suppress stale findings from re-surfacing in maintenance runs.

31b9d6fe-82d2-4341-af2b-a2adc281dbba.label: colonized-node
31b9d6fe-82d2-4341-af2b-a2adc281dbba.description: A KG node whose generic label has been narrowed to one project-specific meaning, polluting retrieval by conflating the general concept with a narrow jargon sense.

aa918516-d554-464c-937c-e3f2e99af486.label: alias-of-edge
aa918516-d554-464c-937c-e3f2e99af486.description: Edge type created by the ingestion and session agents to link synonym or mistranscription labels to a canonical node label for retrieval deduplication.

c27db284-ea98-4d09-bd80-c9cbe61f6c33.label: edge-signature
c27db284-ea98-4d09-bd80-c9cbe61f6c33.description: Structural fingerprint of a node's active edges at verdict time (edge count, predicates, neighbor hash) used to detect re-colonization and lapse suppression when graph structure drifts.

4c080d01-d2a3-4b3b-8784-f7478b4e6084.label: kg-issues
4c080d01-d2a3-4b3b-8784-f7478b4e6084.description: JSONL queue (kg_issues.jsonl) accumulating colonized-node findings and mirrored health flags from the maintenance agent for human review and resolution.

19a7ff2b-c40a-45c0-a38e-63affa6fa7c1.label: kg-merge-pattern
19a7ff2b-c40a-45c0-a38e-63affa6fa7c1.description: Manual merge procedure for duplicate KG nodes: copy loser's edges onto survivor with add-edge, then remove-node the loser — no merge command exists because relabel raises an error when target label is already in use.

4d87e470-c3e7-4d78-9610-7fc0ff2fe432.label: batch-import-endpoint
4d87e470-c3e7-4d78-9610-7fc0ff2fe432.description: HTTP endpoint for bulk KG node creation; preferred over looping /update-node for N>1 new nodes.

8628c5d9-f1e0-4b5d-b931-053dd6071430.label: extraction-prompts
8628c5d9-f1e0-4b5d-b931-053dd6071430.description: Python module (extraction_prompts.py) containing shared prompt blocks (label rules, entity-type enum, predicate vocabulary) used by all three KG extraction pipelines.

7cdaa8a3-175a-4d95-87b2-6019e8dae968.label: ingest-pipeline
7cdaa8a3-175a-4d95-87b2-6019e8dae968.description: ingest.py — KG extraction pipeline for conversations; primary description maintainer with verbose evergreen descriptions and DESCRIPTION EVOLUTION support.

498d5767-41a4-4770-acce-91c3ee0fbcc0.label: diff-sync-pipeline
498d5767-41a4-4770-acce-91c3ee0fbcc0.description: diff_sync.py — KG extraction pipeline for document diffs; adds mentioned-in document-linking rule.

ad222182-c458-406c-b527-b8d107494521.label: workspace-ingest-pipeline
ad222182-c458-406c-b527-b8d107494521.description: workspace_ingest.py — KG extraction pipeline for manual bulk file ingest; omits expirations and causal/contextual clauses.

c8cf0b08-4b22-4ba9-842d-a3828c269597.label: store-json
c8cf0b08-4b22-4ba9-842d-a3828c269597.description: Runtime KG state file (~40 MB); every save rewrites the entire file, making bulk endpoints critical for performance.

c6c669f8-b92f-4ca0-b29a-4b19d2c0e19c.label: orphan-cleanup
c6c669f8-b92f-4ca0-b29a-4b19d2c0e19c.description: The only sanctioned node deletion in the KG: maintenance agent removes zero-edge nodes; never manually delete nodes with edges.

8c941823-19bd-475b-a7c8-8bd03cb303d1.label: silence-alignment
8c941823-19bd-475b-a7c8-8bd03cb303d1.description: Chunk boundary technique that scans the last 5s before a 30s mark and cuts at the quietest ~25ms frame to avoid splitting words mid-utterance.

6d316632-b7c0-4b39-ae4e-e5c778fc8eb4.label: build-whisper-prompt
6d316632-b7c0-4b39-ae4e-e5c778fc8eb4.description: SessionStart hook that builds a comma-separated glossary sidecar from the mistranscription registry intersected with active running context, used as Whisper's initial_prompt.

6f06586b-a88b-4462-ae4f-78c104ce1c43.label: mistranscription-registry
6f06586b-a88b-4462-ae4f-78c104ce1c43.description: Registry of known STT error patterns and corrections that primes the LLM review sweep and drives deterministic data-prep corrections.

77ecfeb5-4969-44ef-84bd-ae7e44fc48db.label: stt-tool
77ecfeb5-4969-44ef-84bd-ae7e44fc48db.description: CLI (stt_tool.py) for mistranscription management: log, pending, auto, manual, reject, flush-mistranscription-edges.

a8c61195-3519-4511-99ef-df8541137bc2.label: tts-hook
a8c61195-3519-4511-99ef-df8541137bc2.description: PreToolUse + Stop hook that enqueues new assistant text for TTS playback via tts_player.sh, supporting both Claude Code and Pi harnesses.

5ebf25d6-4d6c-4b83-8b8a-f7774be8f2ce.label: gpu-exclusive-mode
5ebf25d6-4d6c-4b83-8b8a-f7774be8f2ce.description: Sentinel-file mechanism (/tmp/gpu-exclusive-mode) that suppresses whisper-server unreachability errors when the GPU is parked for local inference.

a5f5b15e-d87d-4c20-b6d3-976dca96f39b.label: whisper-lora-finetune
a5f5b15e-d87d-4c20-b6d3-976dca96f39b.description: Optional opt-in pipeline under voice/finetune/ for fine-tuning Whisper with LoRA on passively collected training data.

5d587aa1-1115-4a39-9c26-4d5db8ed0391.label: pw-record
5d587aa1-1115-4a39-9c26-4d5db8ed0391.description: PipeWire audio capture command used by progressive_recorder.py to continuously record microphone input.

51c35275-f8c3-4d21-a991-cd8944c35840.label: kyutai
51c35275-f8c3-4d21-a991-cd8944c35840.description: Creator of Pocket-TTS, a CPU-native TTS library with voice cloning capabilities.

23f339b5-c374-427b-b90c-ac661b4ffaf0.label: mmr-lambda
23f339b5-c374-427b-b90c-ac661b4ffaf0.description: Hyperparameter (default 0.7) controlling the relevance-vs-diversity tradeoff in MMR reranking; 1.0 means pure relevance.

7188a4e8-c54a-4304-b8c6-b59e1f21eda3.label: inv-freq-alpha
7188a4e8-c54a-4304-b8c6-b59e1f21eda3.description: Hub-suppression exponent (default 0.7) applied in PPR scoring to down-weight highly-connected hub nodes.

57d2f37c-61f2-4422-b9fc-4a02d1364ac5.label: whisper-glossary-biasing
57d2f37c-61f2-4422-b9fc-4a02d1364ac5.description: Technique that injects a dynamic KG-derived term glossary into the Whisper STT prompt to improve transcription of domain vocabulary.

e84d2f69-b9ae-42b6-8879-3bb783e656db.label: edge-discovery
e84d2f69-b9ae-42b6-8879-3bb783e656db.description: Process that proposes new KG edges between nodes based on cosine similarity thresholds, run incrementally or over the full graph.

126fb8fe-8c3e-4562-bb03-7a11c0483898.label: mistranscription-edge
126fb8fe-8c3e-4562-bb03-7a11c0483898.description: KG edge created after a STT mistranscription is flagged a threshold number of times, used to bias future transcription correction.

4b40d7c2-9c03-4405-a996-09fc604c272b.label: lora-adapter
4b40d7c2-9c03-4405-a996-09fc604c272b.description: Trained LoRA weights produced by the fine-tune pipeline; must be merged into base Whisper weights before conversion to GGML for whisper.cpp.

e350aad8-c304-4652-af4b-f59836298703.label: catastrophic-forgetting
e350aad8-c304-4652-af4b-f59836298703.description: Model degradation on general English that occurs when fine-tuning hard on a single speaker's voice.

4dbdc4b4-8762-448f-a2b3-d9cc74e9965f.label: replay-buffer
4dbdc4b4-8762-448f-a2b3-d9cc74e9965f.description: Slice of general English audio (People's Speech + LibriSpeech) interleaved into training batches to guard against catastrophic forgetting.

137a9d76-d524-45ba-a797-9b0b866f92db.label: librispeech
137a9d76-d524-45ba-a797-9b0b866f92db.description: Public CC-BY-4.0 speech dataset used as a forgetting-watchdog baseline during Whisper fine-tuning to detect general English regression.

9be40474-50e5-4590-9f0b-4d915a9c0b5e.label: peoples-speech
9be40474-50e5-4590-9f0b-4d915a9c0b5e.description: Public CC-BY-SA speech dataset downloaded as part of the replay buffer to defend against catastrophic forgetting during fine-tuning.

26eb2fb5-297e-4b98-837a-abd31607c04c.label: pseudo-labels
26eb2fb5-297e-4b98-837a-abd31607c04c.description: Training transcript labels derived from Whisper's own transcription output rather than human gold transcripts; limits the ceiling of acoustic adaptation.

b724bd3c-abf8-4bf1-a6df-73e47789681b.label: english-text-normalizer
b724bd3c-abf8-4bf1-a6df-73e47789681b.description: Whisper's built-in text normalizer applied before WER computation to ensure scores are comparable to published benchmarks.

a816f2fd-141b-4def-aebf-db039f36a4ca.label: knowledge-graph
a816f2fd-141b-4def-aebf-db039f36a4ca.description: Cymbiont's core memory substrate: a property graph where entities and their relationships are first-class Thought nodes and edges. Retrieval combines Personalized PageRank diffusion with label term-matching, injected as context every turn. It is autonomic — background hooks and agents extract, store, and recall knowledge; neither the coding agent nor any operator manually writes or queries a memory. The graph is timeless: no decay, no pruning, every edge weight 1.0.
